partial.scope: one partial first-step and actual held late reply

limits: VM-only; no host experimental installation, shared hub reset or manual power operation in this matrix.
Peers during partial cases are Setup/Diagnostic with three real queries; not active Ready or radio isolation.
Advertising-only cleanup preserves untouched scanning Unknown/Setup. Skipping a STOP does not invent Off/Ready.
Scanning first-step requires prior real advertising Off; all actual required STOP replies must succeed.
Only the first selected initialization step is held. Later real steps and ordinary concurrent scheduling remain required.
Random RF20+2 and artificial guest IN error support are distinct from physical unplug and natural autonomous recovery.
Original failed partial, capture-window failure and rejected non-Rust builds remain preserved; whole issues stay open.
